```{r}
# 1) Find the MSP file that write.msp() just produced
msp_in <- "C:/Users/rsh19/Downloads/MS1Match/vignettes/spectra/fill.msp"

if (length(msp_in) == 0) stop("No .msp file found in the working directory.")
if (length(msp_in) > 1) {
  message("Multiple .msp files found; using the newest one.")
  msp_in <- msp_in[order(file.info(msp_in)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]
}

# 2) Read and replace ALL IONMODE lines
x <- readLines(msp_in, warn = FALSE)

# Replace exactly the IONMODE line (safer than a broad replace)
x2 <- gsub("^IONMODE:Negative$", "IONMODE:Positive", x)

# 3) Write to a new file
msp_out <- "StM16_RAMClustR_queries_pos.msp"
writeLines(x2, msp_out)

# 4) Quick check: show unique ionmodes now
unique(grep("^IONMODE:", readLines(msp_out, warn = FALSE), value = TRUE))
 # spectra × samples

```

```{r}
ramclustR_feature_table <- data.frame(
  feature_name = RC$featnames,
  mz         = RC$fmz,
  rt         = RC$frt,
  cluster_id = RC$featclus,
   
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Map cluster index → compound ID
ramclustR_feature_table$compound <- NA

idx <- ramclustR_feature_table$cluster_id > 0
ramclustR_feature_table$compound[idx] <- RC$cmpd[ ramclustR_feature_table$cluster_id[idx] ]
```

How many RAMClustR clusters per true compound

```{r}
library(dplyr)

true_compound_summary <- StM16_join_annotation_results_2merge_ramclustR %>%filter(!Compound_name %in% c("L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine", "Quercetin")) %>% 
  group_by(Compound_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_features = n(),
    n_ramclust_clusters = n_distinct(compound),
    clusters = paste(unique(compound), collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_features))

true_compound_summary

```




```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

df <- StM16_join_annotation_results_2merge_ramclustR %>%  filter(!Compound_name %in% c("L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine", "Quercetin")) 

# --- (A) fragmentation table (no cluster lists) ---
frag_tbl <- df %>%
  group_by(Compound_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_features = n(),
    n_ramclust_clusters = n_distinct(compound, na.rm = FALSE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- (B) anchor table (choose one [M+H]+ anchor per compound) ---
anchors <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PI_match), str_detect(PI_match, "\\[M\\+H\\]\\+")) %>%
 # filter(!Compound_name %in% c("L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine", "Quercetin")) %>%
  group_by(Compound_name) %>%
  slice(1) %>%              # better: replace with "slice_max(mzmed)" or by intensity if available
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    Compound_name,
    anchor_feature = feature_name,
    anchor_cluster_id = cluster_id,
    anchor_cluster = compound
  )

# --- (C) TP/FN relative to anchor cluster ---
eval_df <- df %>%
  inner_join(anchors, by = "Compound_name") %>%
# filter(!Compound_name %in% c("L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine", "Quercetin")) %>%
  mutate(in_anchor = (cluster_id == anchor_cluster_id))

tpfn_tbl <- eval_df %>%
  group_by(Compound_name, anchor_feature, anchor_cluster_id, anchor_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    TP_core = sum(in_anchor),
    FN_split = sum(!in_anchor),
    recall = TP_core / (TP_core + FN_split),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- (D) FP contamination in anchor cluster (optional but recommended) ---
# Count features from *other* compounds that share the anchor cluster_id
fp_tbl <- anchors %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    FP_contam = sum(df$cluster_id == anchor_cluster_id & df$Compound_name != Compound_name)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Compound_name, anchor_cluster_id, FP_contam)

# --- (E) merge to one clean supplementary table ---
supp_tbl <- frag_tbl %>%
  left_join(anchors, by = "Compound_name") %>%
  # filter(!Compound_name %in% c("L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine", "Quercetin")) %>%
  left_join(tpfn_tbl, by = c("Compound_name","anchor_feature","anchor_cluster_id","anchor_cluster")) %>%
  left_join(fp_tbl, by = c("Compound_name","anchor_cluster_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    precision = ifelse(!is.na(TP_core) & (TP_core + FP_contam) > 0,
                       TP_core / (TP_core + FP_contam), NA_real_),
    frac_in_anchor = ifelse(!is.na(TP_core) & n_features > 0, TP_core / n_features, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_features)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Compound_name))

supp_tbl

```










How many true compounds per RAMClustR cluster

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

df <- StM16_join_annotation_results_2merge_ramclustR

# 1) get core (anchor) cluster per compound using PI_match containing [M+H]+
anchors <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PI_match), str_detect(PI_match, "\\[M\\+H\\]\\+")) %>%
  group_by(Compound_name) %>%
  filter(!Compound_name %in% c("L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine", "Quercetin")) %>% 
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Compound_name, anchor_feature = feature_name,
         anchor_cluster_id = cluster_id, anchor_cluster = compound)

# 2) join anchors back and label TP/FN
eval_df <- df %>%
  inner_join(anchors, by = "Compound_name") %>%
  mutate(status = if_else(cluster_id == anchor_cluster_id, "TP_core", "FN_split"))
# count total features per cluster in original df
cluster_sizes <- df %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(anchor_cluster_size = n(), .groups = "drop")

# per-compound summary
summary_all <- eval_df %>%
  group_by(Compound_name, anchor_feature, anchor_cluster_id, anchor_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    total_features = n(),
    TP_core = sum(status == "TP_core"),
    FN_split = sum(status == "FN_split"),
    recall = TP_core / total_features,
    n_subclusters = n_distinct(cluster_id),
    subclusters = paste(cluster_id, collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cluster_sizes, 
            by = c("anchor_cluster_id" = "cluster_id")) %>%
  select(
    Compound_name,
    anchor_feature,
    anchor_cluster_id,
    anchor_cluster,
    anchor_cluster_size,   # moved here
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_features))



summary_all

```


```{r}
write.csv(summary_all, "summary_ramclustR_feature_table.csv")
```


```{r}
# FP count per compound anchor cluster
fp_summary <- df %>%
  inner_join(anchors, by = "Compound_name") %>%
  
  group_by(Compound_name, anchor_cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(
    FP = sum(df$cluster_id == first(anchor_cluster_id) &
             df$Compound_name != first(Compound_name)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_all <- summary_all %>%
  left_join(fp_summary, by = c("Compound_name", "anchor_cluster_id")) %>%
  mutate(precision = TP_core / (TP_core + FP))

summary_all

```
